name: OpenFillAction
description: Root action. Dutch-auction swap of the budget's token: any filler pays the demanded amount and receives the offer. Restarts its budget when the manager changes the price, so it needs CHECKPOINT_PERMISSION_ID on that budget.

inputs.name: dao
inputs.description: The installing DAO. In a recipe: DAO_REF.

inputs.name: budget
inputs.description: The flow's stream budget. In a recipe: ref(i) of the budget component.

inputs.name: demandedToken
inputs.description: The token the DAO must receive. 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native ETH.

inputs.name: demandPerFill
inputs.description: How much of the demanded token must come back per fill.

inputs.name: minDemandedPerOffered
inputs.description: The lowest acceptable price, demanded per offered, 1e18-scaled.
